   explicit byte size, used only when fileContent is empty\n  previewUrl, downloadUrl\n  canvasId        optional — emitted as pageInputs.artifactId (\"\" if absent)\n  currentVersion  optional — \"application/vnd.ms-word.document.macroenabled.12\"                          : \"DOCX\",\n    \"text/html\"                                                                 : \"HTML\",\n HTML: \"iframe\",\n    MD  : \"markdown_viewer\"\n]\n\n// File types without an entry have no meaningful count (HTML, MD, CSV, TSV)\ndef COUNT_UNIT = [PDF: \"page\", DOCX: \"page\", PPTX: \"slide\", ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef typeFromMime = { String mime ->\n    if (!mime) return null\n    def m = mime.toLowerCase().trim()\n    def type = MIME_MAP[m]\n    if (type) return type\n    if (m.contains(\"pdf\"))                                       return \"PDF\"\n    if (m.contains(\"markdown\"))                                  return \"MD\"\n    if (m.contains(\"tsv\") || m.contains(\"tab-separated\"))        return \"TSV\"\n    if (m.contains(\"csv\"))                                       return \"CSV\"\n    if (m.contains(\"spreadsheet\") || m.contains(\"excel\"))        return \"XLSX\"\n    if (m.contains(\"presentation\") || m.contains(\"powerpoint\"))  return \"PPTX\"\n    if (m.contains(\"word\"))                                      return \"DOCX\"\n    if (m.contains(\"html\") || m.contains(\"xhtml\"))               return \"HTML\"\n    return null\n}\n\ndef typeFromFileName = { String name ->\n    if (!name) return null\n    def n = name.toLowerCase().trim()\n    def dot = n.lastIndexOf('.')\n    if (dot < 0 || dot == n.length() - 1) return null\n    return EXTENSION_MAP[n.substring(dot + \"${n} ${n == 1L ? unit : unit + 's'}\".toString()\n}\n\n// base64 encodes 3 bytes per 4 chars; size can be derived without decoding\ndef base64ByteSize = { content ->\n    if (!content) return 0L\n s.replaceAll(/=+$/, \"\")\n    return noPad ? ((noPad.length() as long) * 3L).intdiv(4L) : 0L\n}\n\ndef formatFileSize = { size ->\n    def bytes = (size ?: 0) as long\n    if (bytes < 1024)                return \"${bytes} B\".toString()\n    if (bytes < 1024L * 1024)        return String.format(\"%.2f KB\", bytes / 1024.0)\n    if (bytes < 1024L * 1024 * 1024) return String.format(\"%.2f MB\", bytes / (1024.0 * 1024))\n    return String.format(\"%.2f GB\", bytes / (1024.0 * 1024 * 1024))\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Resolve\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef nestedHint = descriptionMeta?.fileType\ndef fileName   = descriptionMeta?.name ?: rawTitle\n\ndef fileType   = resolveFileType(nestedHint, mimeType, fileName)\ndef canvasType = CANVAS_MAP[fileType] ?: \"e_interface\"\n\n// HTML artifacts are stored under a generated file name, so the given title is\n// the human-readable one; every other type is titled from its stored file name.\ndef title = (fileType == \"HTML\")\n    ? cleanTitle(rawTitle)\n    : (titleFromFileName(descriptionMeta?.name) ?: \"FILE\")\n\ndef sizeBytes = base64ByteSize(fileContent)\nif (sizeBytes <= 0) sizeBytes = (fileSizeFallback ?: 0) as long\n\nreturn [\n    pageInputs: [\n        artifactId    : canvasId,\n        title         : title,\n        description   : rawDescription,\n        count         : formatCount(count, fileType),\n        previewUrl    : previewUrl,\n        downloadUrl   : downloadUrl,\n        fileType      : fileType,\n        fileSize      : formatFileSize(sizeBytes),\n        canvasType    : canvasType,\n        currentVersion: currentVersion\n    ],\n    fileType  : fileType,\n    canvasType: canvasType,\n    title     : title\n]",
